notes: FamilyMart 萬華車站店 inside Wanhua station, Taipei. Distractors: hanging banner '即日起車站開放飲食(包含列車內) / 請依政府規範維持適當社交距離' (notice), '西3出口' exit sign, partial 凱達大飯店 / Caesar Metro Taipei sign at right, '匠' counter sign.

author: 花蓮縣文化局 / 吳緯俊
attribution: Photo: 花蓮縣文化局 / 吳緯俊, OGDL-Taiwan-1.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Object&id=509153. License: https://data.gov.tw/license. Unmodified original.
notes: HISTORIC photo (1959), grainy black-and-white print, Hualien, in front of the old station on 黑金通. The shop name appears twice: the ground-floor fascia read RIGHT TO LEFT (board order 香 乾 郭) and a vertical sign at the right corner. The shop is still trading under this name at the same site per the source, so it is accepted. Two small lines left of the fascia are illegible. Distractors: 'GOLDEN DRAGON HOTEL' and 金龍大旅社 (right to left) on the upper floors, 國泰大旅社 at left, a partial '...運輸社' sign at lower left.

lines.latin: Wànhuá Cháshì Wénhuà Lǎojiē (Wanhua Tea-room Culture Old Street)

notes: Arch over an alley off 西園路, Wanhua, Taipei. Second gold line under the arch reads '60年懷念飲酒店老街' (年 partly occluded), with association notice boards on both sides. Distractors: a political banner with a candidate's photo, 遠傳 '龍山寺直營門市' store sign and Xiaomi ad at left. A van's number plate (foreground right) is prominent but incidental. The arch name may not be in OSM; fallback search is the area.
source_title: 萬華茶室文化老街街景

author: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局
attribution: Photo: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局, CC BY 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Place&id=200262. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.
notes: TRA Zhunan railway station, Miaoli. Large blue letters on the facade, Chinese characters spaced across the louvres with the English line between them. Distractors: small '歡迎光臨竹南車站 Welcome to Zhunan station' board over the entrance, LED clock, bus-stop sign at right. Taxi plate at the right edge is incidental.

author: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局

notes: 1936 concrete station building, Zaoqiao, Miaoli; name board on the roof with TRA logo. Distractors: wooden '造橋' board over the door (read right to left), township cartoon display at left.

author: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局
attribution: Photo: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局, CC BY 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Place&id=332626. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.
notes: Ceramic roundels on a mosaic wall, Qing'an village, Tai'an, Miaoli. The wall reads 洗 (not the 冼 used in the metadata). Maps more often call it 清安豆腐街. Small wooden plaque at right repeats '洗水坑豆腐街' with 'Mayhin'. The large text panel below is a history board (distractor).

author: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局
attribution: Photo: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局, CC BY 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Place&id=329041. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stone lantern pillar marking the old street in Sanyi, Miaoli. Red vertical carving, repeated on two faces; the small bracketed 三叉河 runs beside 廣盛. Distractors in the street behind: 世奇餅店 billboard, 傳統刨冰店, 自助餐, 肉圓 signs.

lines.latin: Ōumǐ bǎihuò (Western goods; 歐米 = Europe-America, Japanese-era usage)

notes: Restored 1928 Art Deco shophouse at 中正路124、126號, Tainan (former 銀座通). The ground-floor fascia is written RIGHT TO LEFT: board order is '部卸?階 | 店商福五 | 貨百米歐'; lines above are in reading order. The left panel reads right-to-left 階 ? 卸部; its second glyph is stylised and not transcribed (left out of lines). 貨 in 歐米百貨 is stylised but legible. '福' medallion in the gable. Photo looking up at the building. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Old (pre-2020s) Zhongli TRA station front, Taoyuan, seen from across the road. Individual character boards on the roof with the TRA logo; English on the canopy fascia. Distractors: taxis, '上計程車處' taxi sign, FamilyMart sign, phone number on a building at left. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局
attribution: Photo: 苗栗縣政府文化觀光局, CC BY 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Place&id=333080. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted carving on a boulder beside Zaoqiao station, Miaoli. Same station as m332075 but a different sign (stone, old 驛 form, Japanese の, Tongyong-style 'Zaociao'), so kept for variety. The sign says 驛, while maps use 車站. Grass and leaves in the foreground; no-entry sign at top left is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

attribution: Photo: 全國教師會, CC BY 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Place&id=225931. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Rén'ài Gōng[yuán] (Ren'ai Park; final character hidden)

notes: Entrance gate of Ren'ai Park, Puli, Nantou. The name is on the lintel, read RIGHT TO LEFT (board order: [?] 公 愛 仁). The fourth tile (left end, presumably 園 per the metadata) is covered by foliage and is not legible, so only 仁愛公 is transcribed. Distractors: Lions Club emblem on top, slogan couplet on the pillars 照亮別人 / 燃燒自己, dedication plaque '埔里國際獅子會獻建', red no-motorbike notice at right. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: 埔里藝文休閒-仁愛公園活動

author: 姜玫如/透南風文化創意有限公司
attribution: Photo: 姜玫如/透南風文化創意有限公司, CC BY-SA 3.0, via tcmb. Source: https://tcmb.culture.tw/zh-tw/detail?indexCode=Culture_Object&id=299963. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/tw/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large billboard over an old shophouse on 橋南老街, Yanshui District, Tainan. Rest of the billboard is slogan copy (手工作麵日頭香 / 伴手意麵情意重) plus '鹽水區橋南社區發展協會' and a '橋南老街 CHIAO NAN COMMUNITY' logo. It may be a community noodle-shop or product board, not a separately mapped POI; fallback for search is the street. Small 門牌 on the post under the eave: 鹽水區 / 水正里 (small, uncertain) / 橋南街 / Ciaonan St (blurred) / 4. Cartoon bear standee and a scooter plate at left are incidental.
source_title: 鹽水區橋南社區4-1 清朝古道橋南老街/社區文史脈絡

notes: Cut-out letters in a weathered steel plate at the GACC headquarters gate, Taipei, back-lit blue over yellow (Ukraine colours). 總 is in a stylised modular font. The sign shows only the abbreviation 文總/GACC; the map name is 中華文化總會.
